# MDRS-95 — stable lesson ids and optimistic concurrency on course edits

## What was done

**Schema (migration `0015_lesson_archive_course_version`, generated by drizzle-kit).**

- `courses.version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` — optimistic-concurrency token.
  A counter, not `updated_at`: that column is a naive timestamp with
  microsecond precision, which a JSON round-trip truncates to milliseconds.
- `lessons.archived_at timestamptz` — removing a lesson hides it (MDRS-124).
- `course_weeks.archived_at timestamptz` — a week dropped from a PUT is
  archived too. Without this the week's `DELETE` would cascade to its lessons,
  including archived ones, and item 4 of the issue would not hold.

**`PUT /courses/:id` (`CourseRepository.replace`).**

- Existing lessons are matched against the whole course, not per week. A lesson
  that changes week is an `UPDATE` of `week_id`, so it keeps its id in all three
  cases the issue lists (moved week; week dropped and re-added / sent without
  its id; see below for the stale-snapshot case).
- A lesson missing from the payload gets `archived_at`; a week missing from the
  payload is archived after its lessons have been moved out. Nothing in
  `replace` deletes a week or a lesson any more. Müderris and resources still
  delete (out of scope).
- The body accepts `version`. The version check and the bump are one
  conditional `UPDATE … WHERE id = $1 AND version = $2`, run first in the
  transaction; its row lock serialises concurrent saves, so the second of two
  PUTs from the same snapshot matches nothing and gets `409
  COURSE_VERSION_CONFLICT` before writing anything.
- All reads (`GET /courses/:id`, köşk summaries, enrolled list) filter archived
  weeks and lessons, so counts exclude them.

**Session-level endpoints (`LessonController`).**

- `POST /courses/:courseId/weeks/:weekId/lessons` — appends to the week.
- `PATCH /lessons/:id` — `version` required; `weekId` moves the lesson (UPDATE,
  never delete + insert), appended to the target week unless `orderIndex` is
  given. The target week must be a live week of the same course (else 404).
- `DELETE /lessons/:id` — archives; answers 404 for an already-archived lesson.
- All three: `@UseGuards(AuthGuard, AuthzGuard)` + `@Authz(SCOPES.EDIT, …)`
  against the parent course. POST uses `byParam(COURSE, "courseId")`; PATCH and
  DELETE use an async lesson→course resolver (`findLessonCourseId`). All three
  bump the course version, so a whole-course form loaded before them is refused
  instead of archiving what they wrote. They return the lesson plus
  `courseVersion`.
- `PATCH /courses/:id` (course metadata) now bumps `version` as well.

**Client.** Spec and typed client regenerated (`pnpm run openapi:tedrisat`);
`LessonsApi` is exposed as `api.lessons`. Generated files whose only change was
the OpenAPI document version header (0.1.5 → 0.2.0, a release bump) were left
untouched. nizam sends the loaded `version` with every course save and, on
`COURSE_VERSION_CONFLICT`, shows a persistent message with a reload button
instead of the generic error (`NewCoursePage.conflict` / `conflictReload`, in
tr, en and ar).

## What was verified

- `nx affected -t typecheck test build lint module-boundaries --base=413beec`:
  green for tedrisat, nizam-web, tedris-web, landing-web, services (and their
  dependencies); tedrisat 25 files / 409 tests.
- `course.e2e.spec.ts`: 39 tests, including the new ones — move through PUT
  keeps the id; week dropped and re-added keeps lesson ids and archives the old
  week; a dropped lesson is archived, not deleted, and leaves the summary
  count; PATCH with a new `weekId` keeps the id; PATCH to another course's week
  is 404; stale PATCH is 409 and changes nothing; `null` on a NOT NULL field
  (title, type, isPreview, weekId, orderIndex) is 400, not 500; two PUTs from one snapshot —
  second is 409, the first one's lesson is still live; a PUT loaded before a
  POST is 409; DELETE archives; 403 from all three endpoints for an unrelated
  caller and for an enrolled talebe.
- The existing id-preservation spec ("preserves ids of retained weeks and
  lessons on replace") passes unchanged.
- `node tools/ci/assert-openapi-spec-fresh.mjs`: spec identical to the exporter.

## What was not verified

- The nizam conflict message was not exercised in a browser — no e2e harness
  covers nizam. It needs a manual check with two tabs.
- The ar translation was written without a native-speaker review.

## Follow-up

- `version` is optional on `PUT /courses/:id` so that the existing spec and any
  caller that has not been updated keep working. A caller that omits it still
  has the lost-update problem; make it required once every caller sends it.
- Müderris and resource rows are still deleted by the whole-course PUT, and
  `DELETE /courses/:id` still cascades; MDRS-124 covers both.
- The new endpoints authorize `EDIT`, which the matrix gives to MUDERRIS as
  well as KOSK_MANAGER; the whole-course PUT still asserts köşk ownership.
  That difference is as the issue specifies; MDRS-105 aligns the PUT.
- A PATCH `orderIndex` within the same week does not renumber its siblings, so
  two lessons can share an index until the next whole-course save.
- nizam still edits through the whole-course PUT; moving its session edits to
  the new endpoints is MDRS-118's sessions list.
